summary: Reviewed the integrated CLI pipeline, retained call journal, blind-before-generation sequence, source-aware tree refinements, stage repairs, structured criticism, derived comparisons, cache boundaries and monitoring entry point. This phase exercises real Java with deterministic provider fixtures; A7 tests live extraction separately.
findings: No code test or model label is presented as an English correctness proof. New source-facing checks are used in the operational workflow.
Repairs preserve original candidates and previous failed checks; a supported replacement can supersede its parent only for the automatic proposal.
Cache scope binds source packet, independent claims, candidate commitment, actual implementation/provider/settings; cache reuse is labelled a model diagnostic.
Case operators now receive a separate sourced target problem, not a tautological copy of the precedent factors.
Human and external questions are excluded from automatic dispatch; remaining questions are deduplicated with prior actions and explicit limits.
Unrelated existing work is preserved; historical P12 evidence remains protected.
Material risks: same-model correlated semantics, limited Boolean derived domains, explicit-reference/case profile and no calibrated natural error rate.
